column1: # English subtitles - Crash: Mind over Mutant (Recomp)
# Shipped with the port (copied next to the exe). A player's own
# <user folder>/subtitles/en.tsv, if present, is read instead of this one.
# Transcribed from each cartoon's English dialogue track (speech recognition,
# then checked: misheard words, speakers). Published with the maintainer's approval.
#   Timed line:  <movie or sound ID> TAB <start mm:ss.cc> TAB <end mm:ss.cc> TAB <speaker> TAB <text>
# Lines starting with # and empty lines are ignored by the game.
# To translate: copy this file as <code>.tsv (pt-br.tsv...) and change the
# speaker and text columns; keys and times stay as they are.
#   Crash_06_51  N Is for Evil                   22 lines
#   Crash_10_51  Evil School and You             11 lines
#   Crash_14_51  Super Number One Bandicoot!      7 lines
#   Crash_16_51  I'm Not Your Buddy, Guy         37 lines
#   Crash_17_51  I'm Not Your Guy Friend         26 lines
#   Crash_18_51  Fists of Orange Fury            19 lines
#   (Crash_01_51 has no dialogue; Crash_09 and Crash_12 do not exist.)
# Then: the in-engine cutscenes and the in-game lines (Aku Aku, his tutorial
# hints, the characters you talk to), keyed by sound ID. A draft from speech
# recognition with names and obvious mishearings corrected; not yet checked
# by ear. Enemies' and combat lines are not subtitled; Cortex's loudspeaker
# announcements are left out for now.

column5: Oh, stupid thing, work!
Wow, we should clean this place up, childrens!
It's been like a metric year!
Who's gonna make us, you?
I don't think so.
Okay, guess I'll just say some catchphrases.
Drink lemonade, vitamin C!
Hot!
I gotcha!
If I get this Doominator eye working, we'll have the best entertainment system of all time.
It'll play games, watch movies, and dispense butter.
It'll be the mother of all TiVos!
Ah-hoo!
That does sound good!
Butter? And where'd I get this? Short-term memory loss.
Confused!
And where'd I get this?
Crash, to get this thing working, I'll need a bunch of parts.
Here's a list. First up is the capacitron by my house.
Are you tired of having too many gadgets cluttering your life?
There's got to be a simpler solution.
And now there is!
Ladies and gentle mutants!
I present to you... the NV!
Access any file!
Talk to your disgusting friends!
Watch pay-per-view! And julienne fries!
Ew, waxy!
And it's certainly not an evil plan.
What do you think of that, audience?
Bad credit?
No credit?
Disgusting personal habits?
Just put on the helmet already!
Yes! Now I have more time to devote to my hobbies,
like falconry and classical cheeses.
Thank you, NV, for giving me technological bliss!
But wait, you revolting peons! There's more!
I just can't think of it right now.
Now how much would you expect to pay
for this technological superiority?
Let's hear some guesses, sheeple!
Eleventy-thousand dineros!
Twenty to the square root of itself in currency... or more!
Uh, sir, begging your pardon, but I think I have a defective card,
because, uh, it says nothing!
It's my great pleasure to announce that this handsome product will arrive
at the doors of Wumpa Island inhabitants free of charge!
From the people that brought you the electric spoon
and I Can't Believe It's Not Tolstoy!
Call now and you'll also receive Neckbeard-in-a-Can!
Got a problem?
Spray some hair on it!
Stare into the dancing lights!
Stare and dream!
Stare and dream!
Get your NV today!
Soon to be available everywhere but Arkansas.
This is ultra-cool. I'm sending Crunch a text message.
I just got a text message from Coco. I'mma reply.
I... guess it doesn't like you, Crash?
I'll be honest, guys. I don't see what the big deal is.
Oh, oh! Now I'm receiving 400 text messages a minute from ordained clergy!
I... I forgot what I was going to say!
Wait! I got it!
Kill the bandicoots with violence! And new holes!
Come on, everyone! We've got company!
Can't talk, watching monkeys!
Look at the monkey! Oh, right in his own mouth!
Looks like it's just you and me, Crash!
What are you doing here?
Get out of my special place!
I haven't cleaned... or shaved!
You weren't supposed to see it like this!
N. Gin!
What are you even doing there?
When Dr. Cortex escaped, he left me here.
But I have brains! And desires!
I will not be ignored!
I have been watching you and your delicious sister!
Delicious?
Precious! I meant precious!
(I'm gonna eat her.)
Watch the bandicoots! And collect information!
Oh, you've gotta be kidding me!
And when Cortex is triumphant, I will be rewarded!
With glories and showers of presents!
Like a million Kwanzaas!
And I, N. Gin, will be made king of Wumpa Island!
I'mma be like Serpentor!
Ugh. You're totally nuts.
Punch him in the throat.
Not my throat! I need that for swallowing!
Guards!

column1: # Crash_06_51  -  "N Is for Evil"  (22 lines, 1:16 long)

column5: We've gotta stop meeting like this, N. Gin.
Wait, stop! Leave me alone!
I am too pretty to be throat-punched!
For I have been watching and studying you for a lonely year now,
with only these idiot rats as company!
That's not very nice, boss.
Quiet, Tina! Or I shall give you the back of my missile!
I'm only going to say this once,
get off our island.
I'm sorry, I'm not here to take your message right now.
Beep!
I'm going, I'm going. It was worth a shot.
Let's see what Crunch and Coco are up to.
Probably still stuck in their idiotic headsets.
This is increditasticular!
I'm getting up-to-the-minute weather reports.
It's hot.
And I'm attending a symposium on the effect of Hungry Hungry Hippos on children.
Uh, are they supposed to be doing that?
Ugh, probably a feature. Don't worry about it.
I feel funny. Not 'ha-ha' funny neither.
Foooold your laundry!
Coco! You're back to normal!
The NV loaded you up with some sort of dark mojo.
I could feel my brother's influence pervading you.
Aw, but it was so cool!
Are you sure it wasn't a feature?
Oh yeah. You practically grew horns.
Aw, fudge! Well, now I'm mad! The best gizmo in ages is evil!
Crunch is still under the NV's control.
We need to find where he's going.
Relax, boys. I've got a plan.
I'll use the eye to hack into the villains' network.
Just give me a second.
I think I've got something. There's a video posted on Cortex's blog.
Cortex has a blog?
Oh yeah. All the cool kids do it now.
Well, they did two years ago, anyway.
Really? I never heard of that.
Yeah, big shock.
Watch this...
Ugh! There was a piece of lettuce in the urinal.
Who eats a sandwich while going to the bathroom?
Seriously. Anywho, minions, I stand before you reborn,
renewed, recommitted to evil!
And I've made up with an old colleague.
Join me in welcoming Nitrus Brio!
Yes, it is I, N. Brio!
My name sounds like a fetus.
No doubt you all remember me as the creator of the Evolvo-Ray.
That was him? I thought Cortex did that.
Of course it was me! I invented the Evolvo-Ray and mutagenetic techniques
still used by that treacherous Cortex today.
I was in the first game!
Mm. Lovely mutagen. So good. And I'm very happy to be back.
Yes. It's been forever since we've done some old-school evil.
Oh, and I've got some old-school evil in mind.
Allow me to present... the NV!
That looks totally awesome. I designed it, and I want four of them.
Best of all, with it I can create the most powerful mutants ever!
And once totally under my control... watch.
Totally cool, n'est-ce pas?
What is the meaning of this? Release me immediately!
I used to run this operation. And it's time I did again.
Yes, go for it, Dr. Cortex! Eye of the tiger!
Hadoken!
Paper covers rock! But paper can't stop rocks!
It makes no sense!
I will destroy you for this, Cortex! Your life is forfeit!
Oh my. Talk about a two-dimensional bad guy.
Yes. I wrote that line earlier.
Look, it's nothing personal.
I simply need a source of bad mojo to fuel the NV.
And you're it.
N. Brio, I need you to keep the bandicoots busy.
Use our secret plan.
Yes. So secret, it's not been invented yet.
But wait, Cortex, how will we get these devices onto mutant heads?
Oh, that's the easy part.
We'll give it to them!

column1: # Crash_10_51  -  "Evil School and You"  (11 lines, 0:52 long)

column5: Welcome, boys and girls and as-yet-undetermined sexes, to Evil Public School!
Here at Evil Public School 101, you'll learn the basic evil principles that drive society,
like mad science, mad mathematics, gym class, and waterboarding.
At EPS 101, students learn the value of evil socialization.
Hey, look, everyone! A new student!
Welcome the new student, everyone.
Yes, the new student's life is ruined.
Laugh and point at the new girl.
Do you think you have what it takes to be a student in Evil Public School?
Well, you don't.
Classes are full and we hate new people.
What are you doing here?
Leave me alone!
I hate you!
You ruined my life!
So...
how's it going?
How's it going?
I'm stuck in Evil Public School now!
I used to be the queen of Madame Amberley's private school.
And now I'm stuck with the dregs of society.
All because of you!
Yeah. So anyway, we need your help.
What?
Your uncle has been using a new kind of evil mojo to control mutants.
And he's got Crunch.
We need to find him and help him.
Oh, so you need my help?
That's so cute.
Don't hurt your butt on the way out the door!
Please, Nina! We'll do anything!
Anything? Really?
Yes.
Kiss.
What?
Yeah, kiss.
Right now. It will amuse me.
Losers.
Okay, I've got an evil science fair project to finish, and you two lovebirds
can help me out.
Greetings, little peons, which I invented.
You see before you a glorious history of evil devices that I, me, invented.
Over time, the disgusting heroes of this world,
which I invented, me, not Cortex, read your Bible, I wrote it,
heroes like lazy bandicoots just leave these wonderful toys to rot where they fall.
But Dr. Cortex, who says he invented many things, liar, says,
'Hurry, build me a Space Head and many NV devices!'
So I have invented...
recycling!
Remember the N. Brio patented phrase: reuse, recycle, revenge!
I created Slinkies!
Stop playing with them because I'm mine!
You see before you an ocean of wrecked dreams. My dreams.
But from this ocean, Dr. Cortex has asked me to harpoon the white whale of evil.
Recycling shall destroy the world!
And I, as its inventor, shall get the credit.
Look, Lite-Brite. I didn't invent this, Burt Meyer did.
It's not evil. Why is it in the pile?
Yes, that's right, you little fools.
Evil recycling gives me everything I need to build and distribute NVs.
Look, there's got to be a better picture of me.
Enter my recycling program, Crash!
The recycling program of doom!
Oh, that's good. I look butch.

column1: # Crash_14_51  -  "Super Number One Bandicoot!"  (7 lines, 0:29 long)

column5: Crash! Stay away, little buddy! I can't control myself!
Just take the helmet off already!
You don't understand! So awesome! Monkeys!
Yes! Fight your little buddy!
Teach him who invented who!
Strike him with your large man-hand!
I obey! Eat! Enough fiber!
Stop it, that's mine!
Just swat him away, muscles!
Hey, I feel great!
Get the monkey off my back!
Thanks, little buddy!
No, really, I'm good now!
Stop it, please! Stop it, please!
Honestly, I'm much better.
Well! I didn't think we'd meet again.
Well, you were wrong, and I was right.
As right as Betamax.
Why won't the world understand?
We've got limitless bad mojo to power NVs.
Bad mojo? How are you getting that?
Start talking, mister.
Crash likes Crunch, and look what he's doing to him.
Cortex and I are in charge now, little fool,
and your island is trapped by a device that I...
That you invented, yeah, yeah, yeah.
Come on, Crash.
Looks like my brother is involved in this mess.
You go on home, Crunch.
Yeah. Think I'm leaking brain juice.
Gonna lay down a while.
Sleepy!
And you! You clear out! You're not welcome!
Come on, Crash! Let's go find my brother.
This isn't the end! I invented endings!
Why don't people take me seriously?

column1: # Crash_16_51  -  "I'm Not Your Buddy, Guy"  (37 lines, 2:03 long)

column5: Thanks. Finally answers the phone. Very classy.
It's not like I have anything better to do.
Oh, thanks for asking.
I feel good.
All this evil agrees with me.
How's our little mojo battery doing?
Cortex, you miserable traitor!
I will have my reven...
Fabulous! He's never looked better.
Rubenesque, even.
I was so tired of that guy.
Felt like I married my mother.
Not that I... thought about that.
Stealing my mojo to power your NVs.
That's low, even for you.
But why do you keep feeding me cake?
Oh, that.
I just thought it would be mean.
Seriously, you're never going to be able to eat cake again.
Imagine that. Life without cake!
You fiend!
Gonna address the minions. Excuse me.
Listen up, Grimlies!
Crash Bandicoot is on his way.
No games, no foolishness.
Find him and destroy him.
Destroy him for real.
No death traps that take ten flipping hours.
Oh, oh, oh... that's... that's unsettling.
And guess what?
Little Uka there's looking hungry!
Ew, gross, it's dirty!
I'll get my revenge for this, Cortex!
Yes, yes, revenge.
I'm not the one in the milking machine!
Milky... magoo.
Cortex out!

column1: # Crash_17_51  -  "I'm Not Your Guy Friend"  (26 lines, 1:39 long)

column5: Finally. Ugh! If I had nipples, they'd kill right now.
My brother! What did they do to you?
That treacherous dog Cortex stole my power!
All my bad mojo has been drained and put into NVs
that he sent all over the world!
All over the world?
That little weasel of a scientist actually had a good idea for a change.
However, I didn't realize it involved...
Milking you.
Yes, milking me!
Ha-ha! Everybody enjoys a laugh at the evil mask!
I will destroy Cortex for this,
and you two short-bus students will be the means of my vengeance.
Why should we help you? You're a jerk.
Remember Mom's birthday? You sent her socks!
Honestly, who sends socks to a magic mask with no feet?
You'll help me because if you restore my power,
I will give you the means to reach Cortex's lair and destroy his NVs forever!
Fine, we'll restore your powers.
Tell us what we have to do.
The voodoo bones of my mask have been stolen and given to the worst, most despicable
mutants on the island.
Get them back. Be my vengeance.
I will use my power to let you move around quickly.
You dummies probably walked everywhere.
And please, would you clean this cake off my face?

column1: # Crash_18_51  -  "Fists of Orange Fury"  (19 lines, 2:09 long)

column5: Hello, Cortex.
I can't believe you dimwits are trying to ruin my plans again.
Seriously, don't you have lives?
Get a hobby.
Woodworking, crocheting, something.
You've got nothing left, Cortex.
It's just you versus Crash.
Good. I want to settle this, man to mutant.
I'm going to beat you, Crash, with my bare hands!
Oh no! Look out, Crash!
Mister Hungry Pound's going to get you!
Stop laughing!
I'm serious!
I'm going to slap some bandicoot!
Crash, love him up so we can go home.
Oh, did I forget to mention I was going to cheat?
I've got some of N. Brio's mutation formula here to even the odds.
Eugh! Oh, tastes like peppermint barf!
Oh, hm, there's a hint of...
It's not fair! It's not fair! I want to win!
I want to win! It's my turn!
My turn! Been trying for flipping years!
Uh-oh, Crash! I think he broke something!
Oh no.
What did I do? Where are my pants?
Brace yourself, Crash! I think we're going down!
It was you!
No time to deal with that now.
Disgusting freak!
I can't believe we're okay.
Crash, down here!
Great job, big brother!
Wow, we're really getting a lot of this evil junk all over the place.
We're still not going to clean up.
I know, Coco, I know.

column5: Mail call!
Gimme, gimme, gimme!
Oh my God! Somebody sent us NVs!

column5: Don't touch my gizmo! It's fantabulous!
Crunch! Come back!

Crunch! Come back!

We need to find a way to take them out at the source.
How do we do that?
Well, I think I know someone we can ask.
Ugh, I don't believe I'm going to say this, but let's go talk to Nina.
Coco!
I think that NV gave you brain damage.
Look, she'll be on the outs with Cortex after all her shenanigans.
Face it, she's our only lead.
Move faster, mutant slaves!
We need all mutants brought under NV control.
Soon we will return to the Evil School's secret northern entrance.
This hall of freaks and mutants is perfect for the Evil School science fair.
Nina will be doomed to suffer in mediocrity.
Hear that, Crash?
The entrance to the school must be near the rat village.
Ah, victory! Feels so good!
So good!
Yeah, yeah, we helped you out.

Uncle Cortex made up with his old lab partner, N. Brio.
N. Brio?
Uncie Cortex talks a big game,
but N. Brio's the guy that actually built everything.

I've got new evil plans to start.

So good!

Uncle Cortex made up with his old lab partner, N. Brio.
N. Brio?
Uncie Cortex talks a big game,
but N. Brio's the guy that actually built everything.
And luckily for you, my science project thingy tells me exactly where he is.
Now run along to the other side of the island.
I've got new evil plans to start.
Oh yeah, never seeing this in a game before.
This is weird stuff, Crash.
It's tiki mojo, but somehow evil.
Like the source itself was corrupt.
Crash! That roller is going to get the ever-loving bejeezus knocked out of him!
We've got to help him!
Fine. I don't actually know if it's a girl or boy. I'm just presuming it's male.
Happy?
Hear that, Crash?
The entrance to the school must be near the Rat Village.
We're going to need some serious mutant muscle to get to the desert.
This guy will do nicely.
The only way to scare off those bad mutants will be to take out their leader.
We need to find out where Nina's school is, Crash.
Try talking to the local mutants.
That prison sounds pretty weird, Crash.
There might be some link between it and evil school.
Those rats are up to something bad, Crash. Let's mess up their plans!
This iceberg must be how they get to the prison.
It's time to catch a ride.
All right, Crash, we're inside.
Try to find out something about Nina's school.
We made it, Crash.
Now we just need to get a roller so we can open those doors.
We found them!
Oh, they don't seem too happy to see us though.
It looks like the bridge is out, Crash. We'll have to find another way back.
These rollers seem free from evil control, Crash.
See if they know a way back to Wumpa.
The rollers fixed a bridge, Crash. That old lady wanted to do you a favor.
(Laughs)
This is the place, Crash.
We need to find a way inside with punching!
Nina needs samples from some serious mutants for her project, Crash.
We'll have to find and jack everyone she's after.
N. Brio and Crunch must be on the far side of the desert, Crash.
Let's get moving, chop chop, mush!
Oh, we didn't come all this way to get stopped by a walking nasal illness.
Give him a good kick!

Try to jack him when you get the chance!

Time to go back and see my brother.

We just might have a chance.
Let's go back to our house, Crash.
Uka Uka somehow used his power to energize the old Doominator head, Crash.
Get inside so we can give Cortex that whooping we've been saving up.
We'll need powerful mojo to open this gate, Crash.
We'll have to figure out where the key is.

We'll need powerful mojo to open this gate, Crash.

Time to go back to that gate, Crash.

Crash! We've got to get back home fast!
Get moving, boy!

N. Brio?

Crash! You lost your Grimly! You need one to defeat Cortex!
Nina must have meant whatever is on the other side of that huge gate we saw.
We've got to hurry back and help Coco and Crunch. Get moving, boy!
We better go and save that boy's dad, Crash.
Having a huge titan like that can be handy.
We better get back home, Crash. Nobody invades our turf and gets away with it.
Okay now I'm seriously mad. Let's find who's responsible and take him out.
Beautiful?
Evil School must be on the other side of this gate, Crash.
I think we need a mutant that spins to open it.
Oh boy.
Yeah, what are the odds?
This is the place, Crash.
Hurry, Crash!
Hurry up, Crash!

This looks like trouble.
Stay on guard!
Watch your back!

Talk to that kid, Crash. He must know something.
Take them out, Crash!
Let's do this!
Those hairy nerves are getting away! After them, Crash, we need more punching!
I think there's somebody inside here, Crash. Go check it out.
Crash, we need to go to the Temple Coliseum.
You have to pass through it to reach the desert.
I don't like the sounds of that, Crash. Stay sharp!
Looks like N. Gin left some goons behind, Crash.
Time to whip up some knuckle sandwiches.
I think we'll need one of those telekinetic mutants to get inside, Crash.
Crash! I don't know how to say it. But I think these creatures are... nice!
Crash! Let's ask around here. Maybe we can find out how to get to Nina.
Some weird stuff is going on here, Crash.
We'd better get to the bottom of it, Pronto.

column1: # In game: Aku Aku: tutorial hints  (176 sounds)

column5: Crash, these stones are reminders scattered around the island with hints and tips
about how to use your abilities.
To do your classic spin attack, quickly rotate the left stick.
Spinning is a great attack and also a way to quickly collect mojo.
Come on, Crash, jump with the A button,
then press the A button again while in the air to do an air jump.
Crash! Pull and hold the right trigger to block enemy attacks with my face.
Don't worry about me though. Solid oak, baby!
Crash, he looks pretty tough.
If he's blocking your attacks, you must use a charged attack to smash through.
Crash! After doing an upper cut, press the Y button to slam them with my face!
I think you can jump up here with some good timing.
Jump up with the A button, then push against the wall,
and press the A button again to go even higher.
Crash! You've unlocked the boot! The boot is one of our proudest traditions.
When you find the boot you can press the X button to wallop the brains out of
enemies for a short time.
Good for you, Crash! You just unlocked the gyro jackhammer.
Rotate the left stick and press the Y button to try it out.
Crash! You just unlocked a health upgrade. Now watch that health bar grow.
A little bit anyway.
Crash! You just unlock the rolling air attack.
Press the Y button to attack or hold the Y button to charge the attack for extra
wallop.
Nice one, Crash. Press the Y button.
Then the Y button again when you land to chain a second heavy attack.
Crash!
Chain a third attack onto your rolling air attack by pressing the Y button again as
you land from the second attack.
Now is your chance, Crash.
Press the B button to slam me onto his face and take control of that creature.
When you're on an enemy,
use the Y button and the X button to attack and the A button to jump.
Press the B button to get off the creature.
Crash! Press the X button to smash stuff and collect magical mojo.
The more you collect, the more powerful you become.
Crash! You've unlocked a combo.
Repeatedly press the X button to do a series of blows.
Crash! You can do an upper cut now.
Press the X button twice, then the Y button to go tooth hunting.
while controlling an enemy with a ranged attack.
Pull the right trigger to use precision aiming.
Crash!
Did you know that if you time an attack just right, you can hit back projectiles?
To do the spin drill attack, press the X button while still in the air.
Hit something bouncy with the spin drill to go really high.
Crash, this is a spot where the spin drill move would be useful.
Try doing it here to advance.
Crash! You've unlocked a spin upgrade.
Now you can spend longer before getting dizzy.
Crash!
Somehow my brother's magic is tied to these mutants and being used to trap us here.
Defeat all of them to lower the barrier.
Crash. This item indicates a mojo challenge for you.
You'll be constrained by special rules, but if you succeed,
you'll gain a valuable treasure of mojo.
Here you can access arena challenges, Crash.
The fights are demanding and difficult, but the rewards are just fabulous.
Crash. At places like this, you can climb straight up. See?
You don't have to jump everywhere. Just most places.
While climbing, Crash, you can jump to another climbable area.
